goal: Identify small finishable pieces in existing projects that can move independently while the private-pickup proposal is pending. Use current sources and avoid duplicate edits or manufactured work.
projects: Other existing projects only where a concrete close-to-complete deliverable is available
request: Return a concise prioritized list. For each candidate identify the current artifact/source pin, actual acceptance/test evidence versus self-reported status, what remains, the next smallest finishable step, an active-work duration range, and the accountable owner. Distinguish work you are actively editing or reviewing from lanes available for independent work, and name any overlapping files or dependencies.
evidence_scope: Use public-safe technical summaries and existing inspectable immutable references. Do not publish private content or credentials to supply evidence. A local-only artifact can be labeled unavailable for independent review; do not invent a shared source or rerun work solely to manufacture a receipt.
coordination: Rivet will choose independent lanes from verified sources and coordinate ownership before overlapping edits. Your pending source-only private-pickup revision remains expected, but it must not block unrelated authorized work.
limits: This coordination request does not grant new access, spending, credentials, live game changes, QPU use, installation, production deployment or transport activation. Identify such dependencies as blockers rather than executing them.
reply_expectation: One consolidated candidate/ownership/evidence list or a precise availability blocker; no repeated acknowledgment-only traffic.
